messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-serving severity=high — rule=kernel_panic_detected host=h3n12.gpusrack3
pagerduty: Page created: PD-99821 — routed to schedule=eng-oncall-primary
Alice SRE: Ack'd on PD-99821. I'm oncall, heading in. Any customer impact visible?
Bob Oncall: Seeing increased 5xx from model-serving in us-west-2, approx 18% errors routed to that rack. Will paste grafana in a sec.
Alice SRE: thx. Initial check: node h3n12 (gpu-node-17) is NotReady, kubelet Status=Unknown. Likely kernel oops/kernel panic, host unreachable via SSH.
Carla Platform: I can reach the IPMI BMC for that host. Serial console shows repeated "kernel panic - not syncing" and stack traces. NVMe SMART logs show recent 985 ERR sectors but not conclusive.
Alice SRE: ok cordon+drain plan. If we can <5 min drain, we should move pods off and let autoscale handle replacements. I'll kick a cordon now.
Alice SRE: ```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
``` 
Alice SRE: drain started, but some model-serving pods stuck terminating — PVCs attached, CSI timeouts in logs.
Bob Oncall: I'm increasing replicas on standby to reduce loss. Also added temporary traffic shift in routing: set region-weight us-west-2=80 -> 60 to avoid the rack.
Carla Platform: Trying soft-restart kubelet via IPMI remote command (systemctl restart kubelet) — host doesn't respond to systemctl (kernel panic loop). Rebooting via BMC now.
incident-bot: :information_source: BMC reboot command sent to h3n12 at 2759990115
Ops Runbook: If host fails to come back, prepare to evict attached PVs and failover volumes to standby provisioner. Follow runbook step 4.2.
Alice SRE: Reboot didn't pause panic. Serial shows early panic from nouveau driver calltrace referencing nvlink. Hypothesis: GPU driver crash -> kernel oops -> kubelet flaps.
Bob Oncall: Customer impact: two midsize customers showing degraded latency and occasional 502s. CS alerted and posted in #support with tracking ticket CI-4227.
Alice SRE: Escalating to hardware team. @carla.platform please open a hw-ticket and request onsite swap for h3n12. Tag: urgent-gpu
Carla Platform: Ticket created TICKET-4591. ETA for tech is 4 hours. Requesting immediate temp mitigation: spin up replacement nodes from spare pool and remap shard assignments.
Alice SRE: Spawning replacement node pool instance group: `asg-gpu-hotspare-usw2` scope. K8s autoscaler should register new nodes in ~6m.
Bob Oncall: Temporary mitigation applied, traffic shift in place, error rate dropping to ~3% now.
Carla Platform: Noted that some pods had local ephemeral data. We ended with partial evictions; some jobs restarted with cold caches — expect elevated latency for a little while.
Alice SRE: Handing off command to Bob for the remainder of rotation — I need to coordinate with hardware tech. Bob, take oncall for the next 30m and monitor PD page.
Bob Oncall: Taking handoff. I'll watch the replacement nodes come up and confirm all model-serving replicas are Ready. If errors spike, I'll trigger rollback to previous model variant.
Alice SRE: Thanks. Leaving notes:
- root cause: probable GPU driver crash leading to kernel panic on h3n12
- mitigation: BMC reboot attempted, failed; replacement node pool spun up; traffic weight decreased; ticket TICKET-4591 opened
- customer impact: transient 5xx for some customers, currently degrading; CS ticket CI-4227 tracking

Carla Platform: Adding postmortem owner tag to ticket and capture kernel-oops logs from serial console for upload.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD-99821 acknowledged by Alice SRE and assigned to Bob Oncall (escalation closed)
Bob Oncall: noted. Monitoring 15m then will update #incidents with final status. :thumbsup:
